text: {"lessons":["A rising account value over a few months does not prove my decisions are outperforming the market; judge results over longer periods and against a benchmark.","Avoid selling Stock E at a steep loss just to react to a price decline; reassess its prospects and portfolio role rather than anchoring on my cost.","Before adding shares, consider concentration, available cash, and how each trade fits a deliberate plan—not just recent price moves."]}
